title: Length of Digit Code
statement: For an integer register $c$ and a finite list $L$ of natural-number digits, the digit code has length $D(L)$, where $D([])=1$ and $D(d::L)=D(L)+1$ if $d=0$, while $D(d::L)=D(L)+2$ if $d\ne0$.
hypotheses_covered: a finite list L of natural-number digits
